root_cause.text: The function `ublk_check_and_reset_active_ref()` only considered `UBLK_F_SUPPORT_ZERO_COPY` and `UBLK_F_AUTO_BUF_REG` flags, missing the `UBLK_F_USER_COPY` mode, so requests using user copy retained their reference count on server exit, leading to a leak that allowed use-after-free of completed requests.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the narrow flag check (`ub->dev_info.flags & (UBLK_F_SUPPORT_ZERO_COPY | UBLK_F_AUTO_BUF_REG)`) with a call to `ublk_dev_need_req_ref(ub)` to cover all reference-counted data copy modes. The commit description explicitly states: "Fix the condition in ublk_check_and_reset_active_ref() to include all reference-counted data copy modes."
